Description:

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.
  
  
As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.
  
  
The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, renewal, and expansion.
* Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
* Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
* Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
* Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
* Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
* Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
* Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high-severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
* Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
* Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
* Exceptional English & Arabic communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
* Skills for analyzing technical concepts, translating them into business terms, and mapping business requirements into technical features.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
* Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies.
* Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.
* **Fluency in both Arabic and English is essential**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* +2 years in the Salesforce Ecosystem.
* Salesforce product certifications are a plus ( **Administrator** , Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, **Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant** ).
* Knowledge of Salesforce products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy.
* Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Title: Partner Account Executive
Description:
The Role
  
  
The MSP Sales& Go-to-Market Lead – MEA-TRC East is an individual contributor responsible for accelerating and scaling Splunk’s business with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) across the region.
  
  
This role translates the broader EMEA MSP strategy into a focused regional go-to-market and sales execution plan. The successful candidate will support the development and growth of strategic MSP partnerships that generate sustainable pipeline, recurring revenue, and new customer acquisition for Splunk.
  
The role will drive the adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program and ensure that Splunk is embedded or “designed in” within partners’ managed security, observability, infrastructure, and digital-resilience service offerings.
  
The MSP Sales& Go-to-Market Lead does not own or manage the partner relationship. Partner ownership and accountability remain with the respective Partner Development Manager (PDM) or Partner Sales Manager (PSM). This role provides MSP expertise, direction, and execution support to help partner and sales teams build and scale successful MSP motions.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
Regional MSP Strategy and Go-to-Market
  
  

* Develop and execute the regional MSP sales and go-to-market plan, aligned with the overall EMEA MSP strategy and regional business priorities.
* Ensure that priority partners have a clear MSP strategy and execution plan embedded within the broader partner plans owned by the respective PDMs and PSMs.
* Support PDMs and PSMs in defining MSP growth plans, revenue ambitions, enablement requirements, service-development priorities, and joint go-to-market activities.
* Build a clear scale plan to expand the regional MSP ecosystem by onboarding new partners, growing existing MSP capabilities, and driving new customer acquisition.
* Identify priority markets, customer segments, industry verticals, and MSP propositions with the strongest potential for scalable growth.
* Maintain a strong understanding of regional market dynamics, competition, regulation, customer demand, and emerging managed-service trends.

Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support and drive MSP-related sales and business development activities across the region in close collaboration with PDMs, PSMs, and Splunk sales teams.
* Develop campaigns and initiatives that create MSP pipeline, generate net-new logos, and support recurring-revenue growth.
* Maintain visibility of the regional MSP pipeline and regularly review progress, performance, and execution with sales and partner teams.
* Support joint account planning and opportunity development with key strategic MSP partners.
* Work closely with regional and global MSP sales teams to align priorities, share best practices, and accelerate strategic opportunities.
* Support complex MSP opportunities and collaborate with the EMEA team to remove commercial, operational, contractual, or organizational barriers.
* Ensure that partner ownership, execution accountability, and opportunity follow-up remain clearly assigned to the relevant PDM, PSM, and sales teams.

Splunk MSP Program and Enablement
  
  

* Lead the regional adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program.
* Act as the regional MSP subject-matter expert and advocate for the program across partner and sales organizations.
* Advise internal teams and partners on MSP commercial models, pricing, contracting, licensing, and partner economics.
* Educate and enable Splunk sales, partner, and technical teams on the MSP route to market and how to position and execute the program.
* Work closely with the EMEA MSP team to identify program improvements required to address regional market needs.
* Partner closely with the MSP Partner Technical Manager (PTM) to ensure that the regional plan is technically aligned and supported by the required enablement, service-development, and delivery capabilities.

GTMDevelopmentandCross-FunctionalAlignment
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with key MSP stakeholders across executive leadership, sales, technical, service-development, operations, and marketing teams.
* Support partners in developing and launching differentiated Splunk-powered managed services.
* Help ensure that Splunk is designed into partners’ service catalogues across security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, and digital resilience.
* Support the development of partner value propositions, business cases, sales plays, campaigns, and customer-facing propositions.
* Align with Splunk Regional Sales Directors, Regional Sales Managers, AVPs, partner leadership, and other senior stakeholders.
* Work closely with PDMs, PSMs, PTMs, marketing, legal, finance, operations, and the EMEA and global MSP teams.
* Prepare and deliver MSP business reviews and updates to regional, EMEA, and partner leadership teams.

Commercial Leadership and Negotiation
  
  

* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with MSP and MSSP partners.
* Work with the EMEA MSP team, legal, finance, pricing, operations, and deal-desk teams to develop scalable and commercially viable agreements.
* Help resolve complex pricing, licensing, contractual, and route-to-market considerations.
* Apply strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills to accelerate strategic opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working with MSPs, MSSPs, service providers, cloud providers, or technology partners.
* Deep understanding of the regional MSP and MSSP landscape, business models, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics.
* Demonstrated success in sales, business development, partner development, or go-to-market roles.
* Proven ability to translate regional strategies into executable partner and sales plans.
* Strong understanding of recurring-revenue, consumption-based, managed-service, and partner-led business models.
* Experience developing and launching partner-led managed services or technology-based service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting complex pricing, contracting, and negotiation discussions.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across partner, sales, technical, executive, regional, and global teams without direct ownership.
* Strong pipeline management, forecasting, business-planning, and executive communication skills.
* Knowledge of security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud, or digital-resilience markets is highly desirable.

* Drive continuous improvement through automation, digitalization, standardized ways of working, performance transparency, knowledge reuse, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with partners and internal organizations to strengthen the end-to-end CSS offering and expand the value delivered to customers.

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

* Significant experience in telecommunications, IT, managed services, customer support, service operations, or related technology businesses.
* Proven experience managing complex customer engagements across sales, pre-sales, delivery, and the customer lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of CSS offerings, service management, operational transformation, automation, digitalization, and customer experience.
* Demonstrated ability to lead business growth, manage senior customer relationships, and deliver commercial results in a complex matrix organization.

* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
* Proven ability to make sound, timely decisions across competing business, customer, delivery, and commercial priorities.
* Strong executive presence, resilience, adaptability, and results orientation.

Success will be measured by the Client Business Executive’s ability to:

**West Los Angeles,**

Title: Lead - Retention and Engagement
Industry: Entertainment Providers, Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, and Technology, Information and Media
Description:
**Position Summary:**

The Lead, Retention and Engagement is responsible for developing and executing TOD’s customer retention, engagement, and subscriber lifecycle strategy across MENA, with the objective of reducing churn, improving renewal and reactivation rates, increasing customer engagement, and maximizing subscriber lifetime value.

The role will lead data-driven retention and lifecycle initiatives across the full customer journey, from onboarding and active engagement through renewal, churn prevention, win-back, and reactivation. Working closely with Marketing, CRM, Product, Customer Care, Analytics, Commercial, Content, Technology, and Finance, the role will identify subscriber behavior and churn drivers, develop targeted customer segments and interventions, and continuously optimize customer engagement and loyalty.

The position will also oversee the planning and execution of personalized, multi-channel lifecycle campaigns, ensuring that customer insights, content preferences, sports calendars, viewing behavior, subscription data, and commercial objectives are translated into relevant and measurable retention initiatives.

The role is accountable for monitoring key retention KPIs, including churn, renewal, reactivation, engagement, customer lifetime value, and campaign performance, and for providing actionable recommendations to improve subscriber value and long-term loyalty.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

**Retention Strategy & Subscriber Lifecycle**

* Develop and lead TOD’s customer retention and lifecycle strategy across MENA markets.
* Define retention priorities, initiatives, and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, renewal, churn prevention, cancellation, and win-back stages.
* Identify key churn drivers and develop targeted initiatives to improve subscriber retention and loyalty.
* Build differentiated retention strategies for various customer segments, subscription types, markets, and customer value groups.
* Develop initiatives aimed at increasing subscription tenure, renewal rates, engagement, and customer lifetime value.
* Partner with relevant teams to develop proactive and reactive churn-prevention programs.
* Lead and align the retention strategy across Sports and Entertainment subscriber segments, ensuring differentiated approaches based on content consumption, customer behavior, seasonality, and commercial priorities.
* Develop retention plans around major sports tournaments, premium entertainment releases, and key content moments to maximize subscriber engagement and minimize post-event churn.

**CRM & Lifecycle Campaigns**

* Lead the planning, execution, and continuous optimization of CRM and lifecycle campaigns across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, SMS, WhatsApp, and other approved customer communication channels.
* Develop personalized customer journeys based on subscriber behavior, viewing and content consumption patterns, engagement, payment status, tenure, and predicted churn risk.
* Establish automated lifecycle journeys including onboarding, activation, engagement, renewal reminders, payment recovery, churn prevention, and win-back.
* Ensure appropriate customer segmentation and personalization to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Drive continuous A/B testing and optimization of retention communications, offers, messaging, timing, and channels.
* Ensure lifecycle communications comply with customer consent, data privacy, communication governance, and brand guidelines across MENA markets.

**Churn Management & Win-Back**

* Monitor voluntary and involuntary churn and develop strategies to reduce both.
* Design cancellation journeys and save strategies aimed at retaining customers before subscription termination.
* Develop effective win-back programs for former subscribers.
* Work with Product, Payment, Technology, and Customer Care teams to address payment failures and other causes of involuntary churn.
* Develop and recommend targeted retention offers, incentives, pricing interventions, and product propositions based on customer behavior, churn risk, customer lifetime value, and commercial viability.
* Ensure retention activities balance subscriber growth with revenue and profitability objectives.

**Data, Analytics & Performance**

* Define and monitor key retention KPIs including churn rate, renewal rate, retention rate, engagement, reactivation, customer lifetime value, campaign conversion, and subscription tenure.
* Partner closely with Data and Analytics teams to develop customer segmentation, churn prediction models, cohort analysis, and subscriber behavior insights.
* Use customer behavior, cohort analysis, churn signals, and content consumption data to identify retention opportunities, develop targeted interventions, and measure incremental customer lifetime value.
* Translate customer data and behavioral insights into actionable retention initiatives.
* Develop dashboards and regular performance reporting to track retention performance and campaign effectiveness.
* Conduct cohort and funnel analysis to identify critical points of subscriber drop-off.
* Measure incremental impact and ROI of retention initiatives.
* Establish test-and-learn frameworks to measure the incremental impact of retention initiatives and identify scalable best practices.
* Partner with Analytics teams to improve churn propensity modelling, customer lifetime value modelling, and next-best-action capabilities.

**Customer Experience & Engagement**

* Work closely with Product, Content, and Customer Care teams to identify opportunities to improve the overall subscriber experience.
* Use customer feedback, behavioral data, contact-center insights, cancellation reasons, and engagement data to identify areas affecting subscriber satisfaction and retention.
* Develop engagement initiatives around key sports, entertainment, and content moments to maximize active usage and subscriber loyalty.
* Support personalization and recommendation initiatives aimed at increasing customer engagement.
* Ensure retention strategies reflect differences in customer behavior and preferences across MENA markets.
* Define and implement subscriber engagement strategies designed to increase platform usage, content discovery, viewing frequency, and overall customer stickiness.
* Develop engagement programs tailored to different customer segments, content preferences, and stages of the subscriber lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to increase engagement among low-activity or at-risk subscribers before they enter the cancellation journey.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Marketing, Product, Commercial, Content, Customer Care, Technology, Finance, and Analytics teams to deliver retention initiatives.
* Work with Customer Care teams to establish appropriate save offers, cancellation handling procedures, and retention scripts.
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to improve subscriber journeys, cancellation flows, payment journeys, and customer engagement features.
* Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to assess the financial impact of retention offers and initiatives.
* Coordinate with acquisition teams to ensure customer quality, retention performance, and lifetime value are considered alongside subscriber acquisition.
* Partner with Content teams to align retention and engagement activity with major sports rights, tournaments, entertainment launches, and content calendars.

**Planning & Leadership**

* Own the retention roadmap and ensure timely execution of agreed initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Retention and Engagement team, setting clear objectives, accountabilities, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective workload allocation and collaboration between Sports Retention and Entertainment Retention specialists.
* Build team capability in CRM, lifecycle marketing, analytics, experimentation, and customer engagement best practices Establish clear operating processes, campaign calendars, governance, and reporting.
* Manage relevant agencies, CRM and technology vendors, and external partners while maintaining strong internal ownership of retention strategy, delivery, measurement, and critical CRM capabilities.
* Stay informed of developments in OTT, subscription businesses, CRM, customer lifecycle management, personalization, and retention best practices.
* Present retention performance, key insights, risks, and recommendations to senior management.

**Job Requirements and Qualifications**

**Education:**

Title: Senior Manager - IT/OT Network Security - AA9
Description:
Act as the single point of contact between District ICT Operations and Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security matters. The role manages the relationship, coordinates incidents, escalations, changes and requests, and keeps both parties aligned.

* Managing cross-organizational relationships and building trust with Corporate IT leadership

* Clear communication of technical issues, impacts and decisions to mixed audiences
* Influence and negotiation without direct authority
* Disciplined tracking, follow-through and governance reporting

**Key Responsibilities**

* Incident and escalation coordination: Coordinate incidents involving Corporate IT, including major incidents. Drive timely engagement, clear ownership and resolution, and manage escalations through agreed paths
* Change and dependency coordination: Make sure District ICT changes, projects and design reviews that affect Corporate IT networks or security are raised, coordinated and approved through the right Corporate IT channels
* Security and access requests: Coordinate firewall rules, connectivity, access and security requests with Corporate IT, and track them through to completion
* Engagement model: Define and maintain the operating interface with Corporate IT: contacts, escalation matrix, OLAs, meeting cadence and responsibilities
* Governance and reporting: Run regular service reviews with Corporate IT. Report on open issues, risks, dependencies and performance to the Associate Director

**Requirements**
**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Corporate IT network, security and operations teams: Primary counterpart for all IT/OT matters
* Associate Director and District ICT leadership: Escalations, risks and governance reporting
* Major incident, change and L1.5 teams: Incident coordination and change alignment
* Design assurance, project and operational readiness teams: Corporate IT dependencies and approvals
* Vendors and MSPs: Issues that cross Corporate IT boundaries

**Key Technical Skills**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable

Title: Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.
  
  
Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
‎
  
  
The Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring owns the operational management and health of IMCO’s enterprise AI platforms, with a focus on observability, reliability, performance, usage and cost. The role establishes the monitoring, operational controls and support practices needed to run AI services effectively in production and provides visibility into agent and model behavior, platform performance and emerging operational risks. The role works closely with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance and technology teams to ensure AI platforms operate within established enterprise standards and guardrails.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform Operations & Observability**

* Establish and manage enterprise observability and monitoring capabilities across Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform AI services, and future AI platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve monitoring and observability across AI platforms, models and agents, including performance, reliability, agent activity, usage and operational risks.
* Develop dashboards, alerts and KPIs that provide visibility into platform health, adoption, usage, capacity and cost.
* Identify and coordinate resolution of platform incidents and production issues, maintaining appropriate runbooks, support procedures and service expectations.

**Platform Management & Controls**

* Establish and maintain platform standards covering environments, connectors, capacity, solution management and enterprise use of Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Implement and operate platform controls and guardrails aligned with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Privacy and Technology Risk requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access, environment and platform management practices to support secure and scalable use.
* Partner with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Governance and AI Governance to ensure the platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards.

**Solution Lifecycle and Operational Readiness**

* Establish lifecycle and operational practices for AI and Power Platform solutions, including development, testing, deployment, release and production support.
* Maintain appropriate ALM, source control and deployment practices, including Azure DevOps integration where applicable.
* Lead operational-readiness assessments for solutions entering production, ensuring monitoring, support, recovery and ownership are in place.
* Manage platform releases, upgrades and changes and support the transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

**Service Management & Operational Insights**

* Maintain visibility into AI consumption, licensing, platform capacity, costs, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Provide management reporting and operational insights to support technology, governance and risk decisions.
* Manage operational relationships and service escalations with Microsoft and other relevant platform vendors.
* Evaluate emerging platform-management and observability capabilities that can improve the reliability and operation of IMCO’s AI environment.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise platform operations, cloud services, application operations or digital workplace technologies.
* Strong experience with the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform and enterprise cloud services.
* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, enterprise AI platforms, conversational AI or agent-based solutions.
* Demonstrated experience with monitoring, observability, telemetry, incident management and operational reporting for enterprise platforms or applications.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), DevOps, release management and production support practices.
* Experience establishing and operating platform controls, environment management, support models and operational standards.
* Strong understanding of service health, reliability, capacity, usage and cost management for cloud-based platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Risk and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications across Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio or AI are considered assets.

The placement within the range is determined by the range of market pay for the specific position, as well as the candidate's knowledge, skillset and experience relative to the requirements of the position and to internal peers. Title: Senior Security Manager, Assistance

Description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior Security Manager, Assistance**
to lead our regional Security Assistance team, based in Dubai.
  
  
This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the delivery of frontline security assistance services across Mashreq, Iran, East and Southern Africa. The successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership, ensuring the delivery of high-quality security advice, case management, incident response, crisis support and preventative security services to our clients and members.
  
  
Working closely with the Global Security Director, Assistance, Regional Operations Directors and wider global security network, you will drive operational excellence, strengthen regional capabilities and ensure consistent service delivery in line with International SOS standards and client expectations.
  
  
You will also play an important role in developing regional security talent, supporting business growth, strengthening client relationships and maintaining operational readiness in an evolving security environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Management and Leadership**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Security Managers, Security Specialists and associated security personnel across the region.
* Lead, coach and develop regional security teams, promoting professional growth, engagement and high performance.
* Oversee performance management, objective setting, succession planning and workforce development.
* Ensure effective resource planning and allocation to meet operational demands and client requirements.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence and customer focus.
* Lead the Security Case Lead function in coordination with Security Managers.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training and retention of regional security personnel.
* Act as deputy to the Global Security Director, Assistance, in the Middle East region.

**Core Client & Internal Support**

* Oversee the delivery of regional security assistance services, ensuring timely, effective and customer-focused outcomes.
* Provide expert security guidance and support to clients, travellers, expatriates and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain oversight of security case management and ensure consistent service quality and operational standards.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex security cases, incidents and operational challenges.
* Coordinate security responses to emergencies, critical incidents and crisis situations.
* Monitor regional security developments and ensure operational responses reflect current threat assessments and intelligence.
* Provide senior-level review and quality assurance of security advice, assessments and recommendations.
* Maintain regional operational preparedness plans, procedures and response protocols.
* Oversee regional security provider networks, partnerships and the Secure Hotel Programme.
* Support Incident Management Teams and Crisis Management Teams during major incidents and events.
* Promote effective collaboration across Medical, Operations, Travel, Aviation, Network Services and Intelligence & Analysis teams.

**Consulting Delivery & Sales, Marketing Support**

* Deliver high-quality security consulting services in line with client requirements.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of security risk assessments, country assessments, travel security programmes and tailored client solutions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, workshops and business development engagements.
* Deliver security briefings, webinars, training programmes and awareness sessions.
* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders and commercial opportunities.
* Contribute to client retention through expert advice and excellent service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing services and develop new client value propositions.
* Represent International SOS at relevant industry events, conferences and stakeholder meetings.
* Support regional commercial objectives through security expertise and operational insight

**Required Experience & Skills**

* At least 8 years of experience in security operations and planning, including operational deployment in hostile and/or challenging environments.
* Experience gained within private security companies, military, NGOs, government or relevant private-sector organisations, ideally within the Middle East.
* Proven experience in leading and managing security teams, including remote or hybrid teams.
* Strong experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Extensive knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse risk environments.
* Strong understanding of the political, security and threat landscape across the Middle East and wider region.
* Experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Ability to analyse complex security, logistical and threat-related information and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
* Experience preparing reports and providing advice to senior management and decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
* Strong IT proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

**Desirable Experience**

* Crisis management and emergency response experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery.
* Client-facing presentations, public speaking and media engagement.
* Business development and commercial support.
* Quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications & Education**

* Degree-level education in Security Studies, Conflict Studies, International Politics, International Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
* Accreditation or membership with a recognised regional security or risk management professional body is desirable.

**Languages**

* Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Arabic, French or another European language would be an advantage.

**Why Join International SOS?**
Join a global organisation where your expertise can make a meaningful difference in protecting people and supporting organisations operating in complex environments.
  
  
At International SOS, you will work alongside experienced professionals across a global network, contribute to critical security operations and help deliver services that protect the health, safety and security of people worldwide.
  
  
**If you are an experienced security leader looking for an opportunity to make an impact on a regional and global scale, we would like to hear from you.**

The Senior Manager, IT Operations, is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of the CIB’s IT function. Reporting to the VP, IT, this role ensures reliable service delivery, effective vendor and managed service partner performance, disciplined ITSM practices, and strong operational controls across infrastructure, service desk, cybersecurity operations, disaster recovery, and business continuity. * Develop, maintain, and improve ITSM processes, procedures, and operating standards that support reliable, secure, and efficient technology services
* Define, monitor, and report on service-level objectives, operational metrics, risks, and recurring issues
* Manage IT operating expenses, vendor performance, contracts, renewals, and service improvement plans within approved budgets
* Support the ongoing development and execution of the IT roadmap by identifying operational improvements, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements
* Maintain and improve cybersecurity controls and operational security practices, including oversight of vulnerability management, penetration testing, awareness training, and remediation tracking

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, infrastructure, service delivery, or related technology roles
* Experience leading IT operations in a structured, risk-conscious environment, preferably in financial services, investments, asset management, or a comparable sector
* Strong working knowledge of ITSM practices, service desk operations, incident management, Azure administration, Microsoft 365, networking, and cloud-first or hybrid environments

Title: Global Travel Operations & Transformation Manager
Description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Manager, Global Travel Operations & Transformation drives operations and traveler support, ensure consistent service delivery while advancing technology and program transformation. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Travel, this role translates program strategy into scalable operational programs, technology enhancements, and measurable outcomes for a global workforce.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational leadership role responsible for managing traveler support, resolving complex issues and escalations, monitoring TMC and supplier performance, and ensuring changes are successfully implemented across the global platform.
  
  
This leader manages day-to-day program performance, advances transformation initiatives, and brings forward emerging capabilities that can improve how employees plan, book, and experience business travel. The ideal candidate is proactive, data-driven, service-oriented, and energized by learning, testing, and embracing new technology, including artificial intelligence and automation. Success requires balancing traveler experience, cost stewardship, policy compliance, duty of care, and operational efficiency while consistently delivering best-in-class service at a global scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Global Travel Operations & Service Excellence
  
  

* Manage and continuously improve global travel operations, ensuring reliable, consistent, and traveler-centered service across regions and time zones
* Oversee traveler support, case triage, escalations, service recovery, and issue resolution, with clear accountability and follow-through
* Identify recurring traveler pain points and implement preventive, scalable solutions through knowledge content, process improvements, self-service, and technology
* Monitor program performance, traveler feedback, service levels, and operational trends to proactively address risks and opportunities
* Balance employee experience, cost effectiveness, policy compliance, and duty of care in operational decisions

Program Transformation, Technology & AI
  
  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, Global Travel, to execute the future vision for travel services at Equinix
* Lead transformation initiatives that modernize travel processes, improve the online booking experience, and create simpler, more intuitive traveler journeys
* Identify, evaluate, and help implement emerging technology, artificial intelligence, automation, predictive analytics, and self-service capabilities that improve traveler support and program efficiency
* Build practical use cases for AI and new technology, support responsible adoption, and measure impact on service quality, productivity, and traveler experience
* Stay current on corporate travel trends and digital capabilities, bringing forward recommendations that support continuous program evolution
* Promote a learning mindset by testing new approaches, applying lessons quickly, and helping stakeholders embrace change

Supplier & Service Delivery Management
  
  

* Manage operational relationships with the travel management company and other travel service providers, including performance reviews, escalations, service-level accountability, and continuous improvement
* Use scorecards, service data, traveler feedback, and root-cause analysis to strengthen supplier performance and drive sustainable solutions
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners on program changes, implementations, testing, and adoption

Data, Insights & Executive Communication
  
  

* Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into travel spend, booking behavior, online booking adoption, service performance, policy compliance, and traveler experience
* Translate complex data into concise insights, recommendations, and action plans for leaders and global stakeholders
* Create executive-ready presentations and business reviews that clearly communicate performance, risks, opportunities, decisions, and outcomes
* Improve data quality and reporting discipline to strengthen business decisions and program governance

Global Collaboration & Change Leadership
  
  

* Partner across Corporate Security, Finance, Procurement, HR, Events, Legal, Technology, and regional teams to deliver a cohesive global travel experience
* Translate strategic objectives into clear workplans, operating rhythms, communications, and measurable deliverables
* Lead change management and traveler communications for policy, process, supplier, and technology changes. Influence stakeholders across a matrixed global organization, driving alignment while balancing enterprise standards with local market requirements
* Serve as a thought partner to the Senior Manager, Global Travel by surfacing emerging trends, operational insights, and innovation opportunities

**Qualifications**

* Proven years of progressive experience in corporate travel, travel operations, travel technology, employee services, supplier management, or related field
* Experience managing complex programs or operations across multiple countries or regions
* Demonstrated success leading operational improvements, technology implementations, or transformation initiatives
* Experience managing online booking tools, travel technologies, digital platforms, or service providers
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience using data to identify opportunities and drive action
* Excellent program management, organization, prioritization, and issue-resolution skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, and highly matrixed environment
* Experience supporting a large global workforce and delivering services across multiple regions and time zones
* Experience with artificial intelligence, automation, self-service, predictive analytics, or other emerging technology capabilities
* Experience developing dashboards, operational scorecards, and executive reporting
* Knowledge of travel policy governance, duty of care, travel risk management, and global travel industry practices
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships, performance metrics, and service-level commitments
* Experience with user acceptance testing, requirements gathering, documentation, communications, and change management

* Financial and investment acumen: Strong financial management and technology investment experience, including budgets, forecasts, business cases, investment recommendations, and cost-optimization initiatives.
* Cloud-modernization capability: Experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architectures, DaaS and VDI platforms, infrastructure modernization, cloud transformation, and enterprise platform-modernization initiatives.
* Executive influence and communication: Excellent stakeholder-management, executive-communication, presentation, written, and spoken English skills, with the ability to influence decisions across technical, operational, and business groups.

Title: VP, Delivery and Customer Success
Description:
**About Us**
Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As Vice President, Customer Success, you'll take the lead on client health across Appficiency's global delivery portfolio. This is a customer-first leadership role: you'll be the face of delivery excellence for our most strategic accounts, spending your time where it counts most - with clients and the teams who serve them. You'll build the kind of trust that turns successful implementations into long-term partnerships, and set the standard the rest of the organization looks to for keeping engagements on scope, on time, on budget, and on quality. We're looking for a delivery leader who has built their career inside project implementation or customer success - someone who knows what it takes to earn a client's confidence and keep it.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own client health across your portfolio, building the kind of trust and consistency that keeps retention high and relationships strong for the long term
* Champion end-to-end delivery excellence, ensuring every engagement is meticulously planned, resourced, and executed within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standards
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic accounts, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor rather than just a delivery contact
* Match your team's skill set to the demands of each engagement, building and maintaining a resource pool capable of scaling with the business
* Identify skill gaps across the team both technical and interpersonal, and partner with fellow delivery leaders to close them through coaching, training, and targeted hiring
* Provide the kind of direction and constructive feedback that helps your team consistently hit customer success KPIs, not just individual project milestones
* Turn strong delivery into business growth, actively supporting the conversion of implementation engagements into follow-on opportunities
* Build a client base that is referenceable, ensuring your accounts become some of Appficiency's strongest references
* Manage your portfolio's profitability with the same rigor you apply to client satisfaction, balancing commercial outcomes with delivery excellence

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* A career built in delivery or project-implementation leadership and customer success ownership - you've sat close enough to execution to know what it actually takes to keep a client happy
* Direct experience owning the full client lifecycle post-go-live - hypercare transition, steady-state support, QBRs, renewal conversations, and escalation management
* Comfort operating with customer health metrics (NPS, CSAT, retention/churn) as core performance indicators, alongside traditional delivery metrics like scope, time, and budget
* 10+ years in Professional Services leadership, with 7-8 of those years hands-on in systems implementation, integration, or process re-engineering
* 8-10 years working across ERP and CRM platforms such as NetSuite and Salesforce; familiarity with AI-driven or productivity solutions (e.g., the Microsoft ecosystem) is a strong plus
* Experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations, onsite and remote, on concurrent projects spanning one or more industries
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including fluency in reading and acting on P&L statements
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an MBA
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for specific client needs
* Applicant must reside in Toronto Canada.

What Will Set You Apart
  
  

* A track record of leading client-facing delivery organizations where retention and satisfaction are the primary measures of success, not just project throughput
* Deep, credible expertise across ERP, CRM, AI, and productivity platforms, built through real implementation experience across multiple industries
* Strong executive presence - the kind that lets you walk into a C-suite conversation and leave with the client's confidence intact or restored
* A demonstrated history of building, mentoring, and scaling delivery teams that consistently exceed client expectations
* A proven ability to turn satisfied clients into active advocates, converting implementation work into long-term, referenceable partnerships

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Your account portfolio consistently outperforms industry benchmarks for client retention, with false-starts and early terminations the exception, not the norm
* Engagements across your portfolio are delivered on scope, on time, on budget, and to quality standard as a matter of course, not an aspiration
* Strategic accounts become vocal advocates for Appficiency, actively referring new business and serving as references in sales conversations
* Skill gaps across your team are identified early and closed proactively, keeping your delivery capability ahead of client demand
* Your portfolio's profitability holds steady at target levels even as the book of business grows

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering at this level of technical scope and complexity.

* Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and shared technology services.
* Strong knowledge of modern cloud computing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, security, system reliability, and software architecture.
* Experience supporting large-scale, consumer-facing digital products or high-availability digital platforms.

* Experience leading blended onsite and offshore delivery teams.
* Proficiency in Azure DevOps and Microsoft Project or equivalent planning tools.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with experience presenting to steering committees and C-level sponsors.

* Industry experience in retail, distribution or manufacturing.
* Arabic language skills.

**What We Offer**

* UAE employment visa and medical insurance.
* The opportunity to lead high-profile Dynamics 365 programmes for leading enterprises in the region.

Title: IT Project Manager
Description:

The IT Project Manager will lead and coordinate the planning, execution, and delivery of critical technology initiatives. + Hands-on experience with project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, Trello, or similar).

+ PRINCE2 (Projects IN Controlled Environments).

**Skills & Competencies -**

* Project Management
* Strong understanding of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Technical Acumen
* Familiarity with system integrations, software development processes, and IT infrastructure.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Cybersecurity Acumen
* Working understanding of core security domains, including threat and vulnerability management, identity and access management, network and endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ability to interpret audit findings, risk registers, and remediation plans and translate them into clear project tasks, owners, and deadlines.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain strict confidentiality.

* Ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional project teams, fostering a collaborative environment.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving
* Skilled in risk analysis, contingency planning, and problem resolution.
* Adept at understanding complex business and technical issues and implementing pragmatic solutions.
* Stakeholder Management
* Proven ability to build rapport with clients, vendors, and team members.
* Effective negotiation skills to address conflicting requirements and manage expectations.
* Attention to Detail
* Meticulous tracking of project documentation, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
* Strong attention to timelines, resources, and quality standards.

Title: Senior Manager_Warehousing and  Distribution
Description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager\_Warehousing and Distribution**

**Department: Logistics & Supply Chain**

**Job Objective**

This role is responsible for owning the day-to-day logistics execution across the company's operations. The role acts as the operational control point between vendors, freight providers,3PL warehouses, customer service, and internal supply chain teams, ensuring efficient stock movement, timely order processing, and clear visibility on logistics performance across wholesale, retail and marketplace channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations Leadership & SLA Ownership**

* Own end-to-end logistics execution KPIs, including inbound OTIF, warehouse SLA, outbound dispatch performance, return rates and exception resolution time.
* Lead daily and weekly operational governance with 3PL warehouse and transport partners, holding them accountable to contractual service levels.
* Act as the senior escalation point for execution issues impacting customer deliveries, brand launches and marketplace performance.
* Manage and develop direct reports, ensuring clear ownership and a strong execution culture.

**2. 3PL Warehouse & Service Provider Governance**

* Serve as the primary operational interface with 3PL warehouses and fulfilment partners.
* Govern receiving,order processing, picking, packing, dispatch and returns handling across all 3PL sites.
* Run regular performance reviews, drive corrective action plans, and lead contract renegotiation cycles where required.
* Onboard new 3PL partners and new lanes, including standard operating procedures, system integration and pricing schedules.

**3. Transport & Carrier Management**

* Own the relationship with freight forwarders, carriers and courier providers across inbound and outbound flows.
* Drive parcel carrier tender cycles, securing competitive rates and reliable service.
* Monitor shipment schedules, transport bookings, proof of delivery, transit-time performance and exception management.
* Lead freight optimisation initiatives across modes (sea, air, road) to balance cost, speed and service reliability.

**4. Inbound, Outbound & Inventory Movement**

* Oversee the daily flow of goods from suppliers into warehouses, and from warehouses to wholesale customers, retail stores, and end consumers.
* Coordinate stock transfers, urgent replenishments, and shipment prioritisation aligned to launch calendars and merchandising plans.
* Ensure accurate goods-in-transit visibility and timely system updates between WMS, ERP and partner platforms.
* Support stock migrations and inter-DC consolidations as required.

**5. Returns, Claims & Issue Resolution**

* Lead operational management of returns, refused deliveries, shipment discrepancies and warehouse claims.
* Coordinate with customer service, warehouse partners and carriers to ensure timely closure and minimal financial leakage.
* Identify recurring issues and implement structural fixes through SOP changes, process redesign or partner reviews.

**6. KPI Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Own and maintain logistics dashboards covering OTIF, warehouse SLAs, dispatch lead times, return rates, claims and operational exceptions.
* Provide regular operational reporting to senior management on performance, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement projects in execution discipline, automation and process efficiency.

**7. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with planning, customer service, finance, IT and commercial teams to ensure logistics execution supports business priorities.
* Align shipment priorities with customer deadlines, launch calendars and replenishment plans.
* Maintain clear, structured communication across internal teams and external logistics stakeholders.

**Key Competencies**

* Builder mindset – energised by setting up new processes, partners and KPIs.
* Hands-on operational discipline.
* Strong execution and follow-up rigour.
* Ability to lead, coach and hold partners accountable, including under pressure.
* Problem-solving and structured escalation management.
* Resilience under transformation and ambiguity.
* Strong written and verbal communication across cultures and time zone

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering or related field.
* 6–10 years of relevant logistics operations experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial position.
* Strong, hands-on track record in 3PL warehouse governance, multi-carrier transport management and shipment execution.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformation, transitions or operational stand-ups.
* Prior experience in fashion, luxury, footwear, retail or premium consumer goods is highly preferred.
* Multi-country logistics experience preferred
* Familiarity with ERP and WMS systems and logistics KPI reporting.

Title: Manager, Operational Technology Infra-Structure, Hosting & Connectivity
Description:
**Job Description**
Why This Role Matters
  
  
This role leads Ma’aden’s OT infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity environments to ensure reliable, secure, and high-performance industrial technology services across sites. It owns the operation and lifecycle of OT compute, storage, virtualization, edge platforms, hosted OT systems, and industrial network connectivity that enable safe operations, digital initiatives, data platforms, and enterprise integration.
  
  
What You Will Deliver
  
  
Manage OT Infrastructure & Hosting Operations
  
  
Operate and maintain OT servers, storage, virtualization, hosting platforms, and edge compute environments across industrial sites.
  
  
Ensure availability, performance, capacity, and reliability of hosted OT systems including MES, LIMS, historians, and edge nodes.
  
  
Execute routine maintenance, patching, upgrades, backups, lifecycle management, and infrastructure health monitoring activities.
  
  
Ensure OT hosting services support operational continuity, plant availability, and approved digital enablement requirements.
  
  
Oversee OT Networks & Connectivity
  
  
Operate and maintain OT network infrastructure across plant, site, and industrial control environments.
  
  
Ensure stable, resilient, and secure connectivity between OT systems, plant networks, data platforms, and upstream enterprise systems.
  
  
Apply standardized network configurations, segmentation principles, connectivity patterns, and performance monitoring practices.
  
  
Coordinate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, site engineering, and enterprise connectivity teams to maintain reliable OT-IT integration.
  
  
Drive Standardization & Modernization
  
  
Implement OT infrastructure, hosting, connectivity, and edge platform standards across sites and operational environments.
  
  
Support modernization of legacy hardware, operating systems, virtualized environments, industrial networks, and hosted OT platforms.
  
  
Execute infrastructure upgrades in line with OT roadmaps, architecture standards, cybersecurity requirements, and site readiness plans.
  
  
Promote reusable configurations, common operating procedures, and consistent support models across OT environments.
  
  
Ensure Reliability & Operational Resilience
  
  
Implement redundancy, backup, recovery, monitoring, incident response, and operational resilience practices for OT infrastructure and hosted systems.
  
  
Monitor infrastructure health and respond to incidents impacting availability, performance, reliability, connectivity, or hosted OT services.
  
  
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring OT infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity issues.
  
  
Ensure operational support processes protect plant continuity, safety, cyber resilience, and agreed service levels.
  
  
Lead Team, Vendors & Cross-Functional Execution
  
  
Lead the OT infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity team in delivering reliable operational support and improvement initiatives.
  
  
Coordinate with cloud, connectivity, cybersecurity, platform, data, application, and site teams to resolve dependencies and execution risks.
  
  
Manage vendor support, service delivery, technical escalations, maintenance windows, and infrastructure delivery commitments.
  
  
Maintain clear operating procedures, service dashboards, risk logs, and stakeholder communications for OT infrastructure services.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
OT infrastructure, hosting platforms, and connectivity services operate reliably with strong availability, performance, and capacity control.
  
  
Hosted OT systems such as MES, LIMS, historians, and edge platforms are maintained, patched, upgraded, and monitored effectively.
  
  
Industrial network connectivity is stable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise OT standards.
  
  
Legacy infrastructure modernization and lifecycle activities are executed with minimal disruption to operations.
  
  
Incidents are resolved quickly, recurring issues are addressed through root-cause actions, and operational resilience improves over time.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s Degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Master’s Degree is preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Minimum 8–12 years of experience in OT infrastructure, industrial infrastructure, hosting, connectivity, network operations, or technology operations roles.
  
  
Hands-on experience with OT servers, storage, virtualization, edge compute, industrial networks, MES, LIMS, historians, and site-based OT environments.
  
  
Experience leading operational teams, vendors, incident response, infrastructure lifecycle activities, and reliability improvement initiatives in industrial or asset-intensive environments.
  
  
Skills That Matter
  
  
OT infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity operations management
  
  
Industrial compute, storage, virtualization, edge platforms, and hosted OT systems
  
  
MES, LIMS, historians, edge nodes, SCADA/DCS connectivity, and plant network environments
  
  
Industrial networking, OT-IT connectivity, segmentation, resilience, and performance monitoring
  
  
Infrastructure lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, and capacity planning
  
  
Reliability engineering, incident management, root-cause analysis, and operational resilience
  
  
Vendor management, service delivery coordination, maintenance planning, and operational governance
  
  
Leadership, stakeholder management, cross-functional coordination, and clear operational communication

Title: Head of Customer Success & Professional Services
Description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.
  
  
****The Opportunity****
As a Head of Customer Success & Professional Services for the US, reporting to the Global VP Customer Success, you will lead and grow our US post-sales team. You will take over an established team of 3 field engineers, develop them further and grow the team as our US business expands. You will own the delivery of our robotic fleet deployments across North America, from contract signature to operational autonomy and long-term value.
  
  
This is a player-coach role in a growth phase. You will lead key customer projects yourself and work on site with customers, while strengthening the processes, tools and standards that let the team scale. The role is highly cross-functional: you will work closely with Sales, Business Value Consultants, Product and Engineering to align customer value, delivery and product feedback. You will be the senior representative of ANYbotics’ delivery organization in the region and the trusted partner for customer stakeholders from site operators to the C-suite.
  
  
****The Market & Our Technology****
ANYbotics brings robotics into industrial environments where safety, uptime and operational reliability matter most. Our customers are large asset operators and service providers using our solution for autonomous inspection and monitoring across sectors including metals, cement, power & utilities, oil & gas and chemicals.
  
  
Our offering combines the robot platform, inspection payloads, charging systems, autonomy and software into a complete inspection solution. We have proven both the technology and the customer value through long-term deployments and are now focused on scaling our products and platform globally.
  
  
**Your Contributions**

* Team leadership & growth: Lead and develop the existing US team of customer success & field services, and grow it in line with business demand. Recruit and onboard new team members, and foster a high-performance team culture.
* Field engineering operations: Own deployment, commissioning, maintenance and support operations in the US. Plan and allocate field capacity across parallel projects, ensure high utilization and quality of execution.
* Fleet roll-out & program management: Own the US project portfolio. Lead strategic multi-site roll-outs personally where needed, and ensure all projects have clear plans, scope, budget, milestones and governance with the customer.
* Value realization & performance management: Ensure every customer has a value realization plan with defined use cases, success criteria and KPIs. Run or oversee Quarterly Performance Reviews and make the value delivered visible to customer leadership.
* Stakeholder & escalation management: Act as senior point of contact for key US accounts and as the escalation point for operational and customer issues. Drive adoption and change management within customer organizations.
* Processes & scalability: Strengthen and standardize the processes, playbooks, reporting and tooling needed to scale delivery in the US, aligned with our global Customer Success organization in Switzerland.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Sales on expansion opportunities and pre-sales feasibility, with Support on case resolution, and with Product and R&D to feed customer and field insights back into the product.

**Your Profile**

* Experience: 5+ years in customer success, field service or technical project delivery, ideally in robotics, industrial automation or complex technical systems in industrial environments.
* Leadership: 3+ years of people management, ideally leading distributed field teams. Experience growing and scaling an existing team is a strong plus.
* Project & Customer Success background: Proven track record of leading multi-site, multi-stakeholder deployments and taking ownership of customer outcomes and value realization.
* Stakeholder management: Confident with senior stakeholders and skilled at driving adoption in industrial environments such as oil and gas, chemicals or utilities.
* Technical depth: Hands-on technical understanding of robotic or automated systems, able to lead troubleshooting and support your engineers in the field.
* Data-driven: You manage your team and customers with KPIs and use data to build a clear business value story.
* Education: Degree in Engineering or a related technical field
* Travel & Location: Based in the US with authorization to work in the US. Willing to travel up to 50%, mainly within North America, and comfortable working directly in customer environments.
* Mindset: Hands-on and accountable leader who develops people and scales teams, able to operate in a fast-growing company and a distributed setup with headquarters in Switzerland.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Title: Area Security Manager, Amazon Corporate Security
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Corporate Security is looking for an experienced, self-motivated, corporate security leader who embodies Amazon’s Leadership Principles, in particular, Customer Obsession, Ownership, Earn Trust, and Bias for Action, to join the team as an Area Security Manager for the Mid-Atlantic and Mid-West region.
  
  
The Area Security Manager reports to a Regional Security Manager, who leads a team of security experts. The Area Security Manager is responsible for implementation of all elements of the Corporate Security program at all Amazon corporate locations in their area of responsibility. The Area Security Manager supports the Regional Security Manager with delivery and oversight of the day-to-day security operations at multiple sites across multiple locations in a highly ambiguous and dynamically fluid environment. The Area Security Manager conducts security assessments, ensures that the corporate sites meet or exceed all requisite security standards, and manages incidents and supporting crisis response. Finally, the Area Security Manager provides security consultancy to local business leadership, develops plans to mitigate gaps in security controls, and manages the guarding and access control programs.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Deliver best-in-class security services focused on enhancing the safety and security of all Amazon employees, contractors, and visitors.
  
  
Manage day-to-day security operations for a diverse portfolio of sites and customers with unique requirements.
  
  
Manage a team of security personnel.  
  
Implement and improve security plans, policies, and programs.
  
  
Coordinate security incident response.
  
  
Respond to customer security concerns.
  
  
Monitor the external threat environments in the defined area and take measures to minimize security risk to the business to the dynamic security environment.
  
  
Successfully align ACS metrics, goals, and strategic direction across the geographic area to support the overall team and organizational mission.
  
Earn trust through key customer and stakeholder engagements, and liaison with external partners.
  
  
Be the trusted security advisor and subject matter expert in the assigned area of responsibility, through high quality communication and excellent briefing skills.
  
  
Communicate accurately and in a timely manner with stakeholders at the tactical and strategic level.
  
  
Build and maintain close relationships with peers at other security functions at Amazon to exchange and share security concerns and collaborate on closing gaps and building best practices.
  
  
A day in the life  
Oversee guarding operations and hold guarding vendors accountable for the quality-of-service delivery. This includes identifying opportunities for cost efficiencies and frugality.
  
  
Build relationships through coordination with internal and external security partners including local law enforcement.
  
  
Develop and monitor performance metrics to track and improve individual, team, system, and site performance. Implement effective, predictable, and measurable processes and procedures to be communicated clearly among Amazon stakeholders.
  
  
Develop and deliver plans, based on risk assessments, to close any potential gaps in security controls.
  
  
Conduct site security assessments and identify trends in findings and develop and implement measures to address systemic issues.
  
Plan and lead drills, tabletop exercises, and other security readiness activities across sites.
  
  
Manage cross-functional projects and operations. Drive team(s)/partners to meet program and/or product goals.
  
  
Conduct initial incident investigations, triage incidents and collaborate with specialist security teams to support the customer.
  
  
Coordinate corporate security support to events.
  
  
Support the maintenance and testing of business continuity plans.
  
Conduct customer outreach and support organizational safety and security initiatives.
  
  
Monitor physical security device installation, commissioning checks of new buildings; and ongoing maintenance activities, including engagement with vendors.  
  
  
  
About the team  
The Amazon Corporate Security team drives security operations for Protective Services at corporate sites worldwide. Divided in three regions (Americas; Asia Pacific; and Europe, Middle East, and Africa), Amazon Corporate Security is a team of security experts who work closely together to protect and secure Amazon’s people and business.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
